description: This file contains unit tests for Orleans grain state persistence using Azure Cosmos DB as the storage provider. It defines a test class with multiple test methods to verify read, write, clear, and format change operations on the Cosmos storage provider.

classes.name: PersistenceProviderTests_Cosmos
classes.description: A test class for verifying Orleans grain state persistence with Azure Cosmos DB, including read/write/clear operations and format changes.

classes.name: TestStoreGrainStateWithCustomJsonProperties
classes.description: A helper class for creating grain state with custom JSON property names and generating random string data.

methods.name: InitializeStorage
methods.description: Initializes and configures a CosmosGrainStorage instance for testing.

methods.name: PersistenceProvider_Azure_Read
methods.description: Test method for reading grain state from Cosmos storage.

methods.name: PersistenceProvider_Azure_WriteRead
methods.description: Test method for writing and then reading grain state to/from Cosmos storage.

methods.name: PersistenceProvider_Azure_WriteClearRead
methods.description: Test method for writing, clearing, and then reading grain state from Cosmos storage.

methods.name: PersistenceProvider_Azure_ChangeReadFormat
methods.description: Test method for changing the read format of stored grain state.

methods.name: PersistenceProvider_Azure_ChangeWriteFormat
methods.description: Test method for changing the write format of stored grain state.

methods.name: Test_PersistenceProvider_Read
methods.description: Helper method to test reading grain state and verifying correctness.

methods.name: Test_PersistenceProvider_WriteRead
methods.description: Helper method to test writing and reading grain state, verifying data integrity.

methods.name: Test_PersistenceProvider_WriteClearRead
methods.description: Helper method to test writing, clearing, and reading grain state, verifying reset.
